notes: Ruka 0.4.3: 100-task eval suite and enforced CI gate. The deterministic suite passes 100/100 at a 95% threshold. Adds npm run eval:deterministic and .github/workflows/eval.yml, which runs typecheck, the deterministic suite and eval:gate on every push and pull request. Model quality is unchanged: the latest baseline is 29/50 at 58% on qwen2.5-coder:7b, so the model gate is still not met. This release expands coverage and enforces the deterministic gate rather than claiming the model score improved.
